basis: Asked by the agent on 26 November 2026 how Tjusta should reach main, and told that it cannot pass the full release review yet (no independent survey control, the routing not confirmed by the club or a round, the outlines not reviewed by the owner), the owner chose "Owner acceptance": a dated record that admits Tjusta as advisory, as Bro Hof was on 24 November, and names all five open items.

open.canonical-control-pending: No independent horizontal or RH 2000 ground control has been measured at Tjusta. The frame is the 1 m national terrain and the orthophotos of four years, which agree with each other.
open.canonical-frame: The ground's origin is fixed in software and has not been approved against independent control, as at every other ground.
open.release-review: The 14-gate release review does not exist: no phone timings, no per-hole review by a person, no offline or rollback rehearsal on this candidate.
open.routing-unconfirmed: The club publishes no hole map and no hole-by-hole card. The routing is read from four photo years and the laser's tee decks against the card Golf i Sverige and Caddee print alike, and from Golf i Sverige's hole plates registered on the photo (16 of 18 fit; the two par 3s were read by eye). The red tees of holes 4 and 18 are on no plate and stand 8.9 and 13.7 m from the card. Nobody who has played the course has confirmed it.
open.surface-intake-pending: All 18 holes were traced on the 2025 orthophoto with three more photo years beside it; the agent's look at every ring is recorded, and a blind second look's 19 doubts are answered (12 stand, 7 are stated faults: six bunkers and the 18th tee's extension are newer than the 2021 laser). The 10th green's front shows on no photo. The owner has not reviewed the outlines.
